title: Centered content column with full bleed breakouts
when: The user wants page content centered in a readable column while some bands, maps or images run the full width.
prompt:
Goal: One grid that centers content at a max width and lets chosen elements break out to the full viewport.
Steps:
1. Page grid: grid-template-columns: [full-start] minmax(var(--space-4), 1fr) [content-start] min(65ch, 100% - 2 * var(--space-4)) [content-end] minmax(var(--space-4), 1fr) [full-end].
2. Put every child in the content track by default: .page > * { grid-column: content }.
3. Add .full-bleed { grid-column: full } for hero bands, maps and wide photos; add a named wide track if tables need more room.
4. Let the outer minmax tracks give the phone gutter so text never touches the edge.
5. For simple pages a .container with max-width: 70rem, margin-inline: auto and padding-inline is enough; never mix both methods.
Quality bar:
- Text column stays at 60 to 75 characters.
- Breakouts cause no horizontal scroll.
- Same side gutter on every section.
Pitfalls:
- width: 100vw breakouts that overflow by the scrollbar width.
- Nested containers each adding padding.
- Centering with fixed px margins.
Verify:
- [ ] One centering method in use.
- [ ] Breakouts use grid-column.
- [ ] Gutter at 375 px is at least 16 px.
- [ ] No horizontal scroll.
Output: The page grid and the .full-bleed utility in style.css.

examples.input: texto centralizado mas com fotos ocupando a tela toda
examples.output: named grid lines full and content, .full-bleed on photo bands, text column min(65ch, 100% - 2rem)
